/* Decorative rising bubbles (Banner, CTA) */
.ajx-abt:not(#ajx-n) .ajx-bubbles { position: absolute; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0; }
.ajx-abt:not(#ajx-n) .ajx-bubbles i { position: absolute; bottom: -70px; width: var(--s); aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 32% 28%, rgba(255,255,255,.95) 0 7%, rgba(255,255,255,.2) 22%, rgba(255,255,255,.05) 62%); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.4); animation: ajxAbtRise var(--d) linear infinite; animation-delay: var(--dl); }
.ajx-abt:not(#ajx-n) .ajx-bubbles i:nth-child(1) { left: 5%; --s: 30px; --d: 17s; --dl: -3s; }
.ajx-abt:not(#ajx-n) .ajx-bubbles i:nth-child(2) { left: 24%; --s: 46px; --d: 23s; --dl: -14s; }
.ajx-abt:not(#ajx-n) .ajx-bubbles i:nth-child(3) { left: 49%; --s: 60px; --d: 27s; --dl: -18s; }
.ajx-abt:not(#ajx-n) .ajx-bubbles i:nth-child(4) { left: 67%; --s: 34px; --d: 20s; --dl: -11s; }
.ajx-abt:not(#ajx-n) .ajx-bubbles i:nth-child(5) { left: 87%; --s: 50px; --d: 25s; --dl: -9s; }
@keyframes ajxAbtRise { 0% { transform: translate(0,0); opacity: 0; } 10% { opacity: 1; } 100% { transform: translate(24px,-120vh); opacity: .2; } }

/* Second gradient layer under the Banner/CTA native background */
.ajx-abt:not(#ajx-n) .ajx-glow-banner { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0; pointer-events: none; background: radial-gradient(700px 300px at 85% 0%, rgba(90,160,255,.5), transparent 60%); }
.ajx-abt:not(#ajx-n) .ajx-glow-cta { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0; pointer-events: none; background: radial-gradient(700px 400px at 100% 0%, rgba(90,160,255,.5), transparent 60%); }

/* object-position/aspect-ratio exceptions — Elementor's native Image widget has no object-position control (and the exact Aspect Ratio control's key name couldn't be confirmed against a real install); these are position/sizing-only, never typography */
.ajx-abt:not(#ajx-n) .ajx-img-journey img { object-position: 60% 50%; aspect-ratio: 1; }
.ajx-abt:not(#ajx-n) .ajx-img-ceo img, .ajx-abt:not(#ajx-n) .ajx-img-emily img, .ajx-abt:not(#ajx-n) .ajx-img-joshua img { object-position: 50% 20%; }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .ajx-abt:not(#ajx-n) .ajx-bubbles i { animation: none !important; }
}
</style>

settings.title: Our Journey in the Production Industry

settings.editor: Founded in 2025, Ajalisco started as a humble sachet water factory in Nigeria, driven by a big dream to provide quality hydration. Today, we have grown into a trusted brand known for delivering clean water and wholesome bread. Our products are crafted with honesty, hygiene, and care, dedicated to serving our community with integrity. Our continuous growth reflects our unwavering commitment to quality and the well-being of the people we serve.

settings.description_text: To produce safe, high-quality consumables—including sachet water and wholesome bread—that nourish and delight families across Nigeria.

To be Nigeria's most trusted producer of high-quality, affordable, and nutritious products—delivering refreshment, health, and happiness to every home. We aspire to expand our reach, uphold the highest standards of hygiene and integrity, and positively impact the communities we serve through innovation and excellence.

settings.editor: We are committed to producing products that meet the highest standards of safety, hygiene, and quality to ensure our customers receive only the best.
Honesty and transparency guide everything we do, from sourcing ingredients to delivering our products to your hands.
Our customers are at the heart of our business. We strive to exceed expectations and foster trust through consistent excellence.
We continuously seek ways to improve our products and processes, embracing new ideas to serve our community better.
We are dedicated to environmentally responsible practices that promote the well-being of our planet and future generations.
Our growth is intertwined with the well-being of our community. We aim to contribute positively through our products and practices.

A certified Mechanical Engineer with 22 years of experience in manufacturing, process optimization, maintenance, and quality control. Under his visionary leadership, the company has evolved from a small sachet water producer to a trusted Nigerian brand. Committed to innovation, quality, and community development, Engr. Ajala emphasizes integrity, teamwork, and continuous improvement to drive sustainable growth.

The driving force behind Ajalisco Production Industries Ltd, overseeing production of sachet water and bread. With a strong focus on quality, hygiene, and innovation, she ensures that every product meets the highest standards. Her background in Science Laboratory Technology and Microbiology enables her to uphold strict safety and quality protocols, reaffirming our commitment to delivering trustworthy products to our community.

A Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering graduate with a B.Eng in Mechanical Engineering. With a hands-on approach and strong foundation in technical systems, he oversees operations, streamlines processes, and ensures product quality. Driven by excellence, innovation, and efficiency, Joshua plays a key role in scaling the company's production, logistics, and customer satisfaction.
Proudly Made in Nigeria, Trusted by Thousands
Let's bring clean water and fresh bread to more homes in Nigeria.
